name: Earthy Craft
signature: Linen paper, moss green, soft old-style serif, taped polaroid photos, hand underline.

contrast.note: Light theme. Moss green is safe as text on both backgrounds. Linen labels on moss buttons pass AA.

type.eyebrow: 0.875rem, weight 600, moss color, sentence case, with a short hand-drawn wavy underline

motion.rule: Settle: photos and cards rise 28px over 850ms with a 100ms stagger, like objects being set down on a table.

hero.layout: Headline and short story on the left. On the right, two or three real photos as white-bordered polaroids (12px border, rotated -3deg, 2deg and -1deg), overlapping, each with a strip of semi-transparent tape and a handwritten-style caption in the body font.
hero.photo: Real photos of the work, tools and people; at least two.

background: Linen with a 5% SVG noise grain. One hand-drawn wavy underline (a single SVG stroke in moss) under the key word of the hero headline. Surface color for alternating bands.

button.fill: Accent fill, linen label; secondary is an underlined text link.
button.label: Body sans, weight 600, sentence case.
button.hover: Press feedback with data-press; underline grows with scaleX on the link.
